1996 Ford F-250 XLT Extended Cab Long Bed — One-Owner Southern California Truck — 96K Miles

Every once in a while, we step outside of Toyota Land for something that is simply too good to pass up, and this 1996 Ford F-250 XLT is exactly that kind of truck.

I bought this truck for two reasons. First, because it was soooooo clean. And second, because it immediately took me back to the early days of Tyacke Motors. When I was a young kid growing up around the dealership, these were the trucks we sold. Clean, low-mileage, well-cared-for F-150s and F-250s like this were everywhere on our lot. The minute I saw this one, it brought back a lot of memories, and I knew I had to buy it.

This is an absolutely exceptional one-owner Southern California F-250 with just 96,000 original miles, and it has spent its entire life in Chula Vista, California. Finished in classic green over a gray cloth interior, this truck is about as honest, original, and well-preserved as a 30-year-old Ford gets.

Under the hood is Ford’s 5.8-liter V8 small block, paired with an automatic transmission and rear-wheel drive. It’s a fantastic old-school combination—simple, proven, and exactly what you want in a classic F-250.

This is an XLT Extended Cab Long Bed and is very well equipped for its era, including power windows, power door locks, cruise control, tilt steering, leather-wrapped steering wheel, cloth seating, carpeted floors, six-passenger seating with a fold-down center armrest, an 8-foot bed, and factory dual fuel tanks.

And then there are the details that make this truck so much fun.

The dash still houses its original factory cassette deck, and underneath the rear seat is a wonderfully period-correct Kenwood 10-disc CD changer. But our favorite piece is hanging underneath the center of the dash: a full-on, very-1990s CB radio—and yes, it works perfectly! You simply couldn't script a better collection of period accessories for a truck like this.

Cosmetically, this F-250 is phenomenal. The body is laser straight, with no road rash, no rock chips, and not a single noticeable ding or dent. The factory chrome bumpers are straight and beautiful, the paint presents exceptionally well, and the truck retains the wonderfully original appearance that makes these increasingly difficult to find.

The interior is every bit as impressive. It is smoke-free and exceptionally well preserved, with no rips, tears, excessive wear, or abuse. The seats, carpet, dash, door panels, controls, and trim all reflect the life this truck has lived. It was clearly owned by someone who cared about it.

It also comes with an excellent documented service history and a clean CARFAX with no reported accidents or damage history.

We have thoroughly gone through, serviced, and inspected the truck, including Brand-new tires all the way around, new intake manifold gaskets, new clutch master cylinder, new brakes, new mass airflow sensor, new oxygen sensors, fresh fluids, fresh filters, and additional maintenance as needed. Everything has been addressed so the next owner can simply get in and enjoy it.

Most importantly, it runs and drives absolutely beautifully. It feels tight, smooth, quiet, and incredibly well cared for—the kind of truck where the condition tells the story long before you ever look at the odometer.

There really is no better way to describe this F-250:

This is the definition of a gentleman’s truck.

One owner. Southern California since new. 96K original miles. 5.8L V8. Eight-foot bed. Dual tanks. Beautiful original condition. And just enough perfectly preserved 1990s nostalgia—including a working CB radio—to make you smile every time you climb behind the wheel.

description:
This 2014 Ram 1500 Big Horn Crew Cab 4x4 is the kind of older half-ton that still checks a lot of the right boxes: 5.7L HEMI V8 power, an 8-speed automatic, heated seats and steering wheel, navigation, a power sunroof, and factory towing equipment. Finished in Maximum Steel Metallic Clearcoat, it combines the HEMI with an Electric Shift-On-Demand Transfer Case and 3.55 rear axle ratio for a strong mix of everyday drivability and truck capability.

The exterior gets the classic Big Horn treatment with 20-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels, a bright billet-style grille, fog lamps, dual rear exhaust with bright tips, and HEMI badging. A factory spray-in bedliner adds useful protection to the bed, while the Power Sunroof is an uncommon and desirable addition on a pickup of this era.

Inside, this truck is considerably better equipped than a basic Big Horn. Premium cloth bucket seats, heated front seats, a heated steering wheel, 10-way power driver's seat with power lumbar, full-length floor console, and rear 60/40 split-folding seat create a comfortable and functional cabin. The Luxury Group adds details including power heated folding mirrors, auto-dimming mirrors, illuminated vanity mirrors, and a Universal Garage Door Opener.

For 2014, the technology package was impressive. Uconnect 8.4AN with an 8.4-inch touchscreen and GPS Navigation is joined by HD Radio, Integrated Voice Command with Bluetooth, a media hub, SD card slot, and a 9-speaker amplified audio system with subwoofer.

The Remote Start and Security Group adds Remote Start and a security alarm, while the Rear Camera and Park Assist Group provides both a ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera and ParkSense Front/Rear Park Assist Systemespecially useful equipment on a full-size Crew Cab pickup.

Ram also equipped this truck for real pickup duty. A Class IV Receiver Hitch, heavy-duty engine cooling, heavy-duty transmission oil cooler, 6,900-pound GVWR, and 3.55 rear axle ratio complement the HEMI V8 and 4x4 drivetrain.

The 2014 Ram 1500 was also one of the most acclaimed pickups of its time. MotorTrend named the Ram 1500 its 2014 Truck of the Year, giving Ram back-to-back Truck of the Year wins, while the model was also recognized for the refinement and innovation that helped reshape expectations for a full-size pickup.

With its 5.7L HEMI V8, 8-speed automatic, 4x4, 20-inch chrome-clad wheels, heated seats and steering wheel, Power Sunroof, Uconnect 8.4AN Navigation, 9-speaker amplified audio, Remote Start, ParkView camera, ParkSense Front/Rear Park Assist, spray-in bedliner, and Class IV Receiver Hitch, this 2014 Ram 1500 Big Horn is an unusually well-equipped example that still offers an appealing combination of HEMI performance, comfort, technology, towing capability, and classic Ram truck styling.

Visit us today to experience the Nissan Titan PRO-4X and discover why this pickup continues to be a trusted choice for truck enthusiasts.

Finished in striking Agate Black with a matching black interior, this used model offers a rugged look paired with modern technology. Its spacious four-door design seats five comfortably, making it ideal for both daily driving and hauling gear. Equipped with a tow package, it’s ready to handle heavy loads, while features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio, and Wi-Fi hotspot enhance connectivity on the go.

This used Ford F-150 Raptor is packed with safety and security features designed to keep occupants safe. Rear parking sensors provide assistance during parking maneuvers, complemented by four-wheel ABS for improved braking control. Emergency braking preparation and cornering brake control add extra layers of safety during unexpected situations. Auto-locking power door locks and a programmable safety key offer added security, while off-road driving assist with hill descent control makes tackling tough terrain easier. The electronic parking brake automatically engages when needed, ensuring stability. These features combine to deliver peace of mind whether on city streets or rugged trails.

2020 Ford F-150 Safety and Security Features

This model comes equipped with rear parking sensors and four-wheel ABS to enhance safety during parking and braking. Emergency braking preparation and cornering brake control improve response during critical moments. Auto-locking power door locks and a programmable safety key help secure the vehicle when unattended. Off-road driving assist with hill descent control simplifies rocky or steep descents. An electronic parking brake with auto-off adds convenience and safety, ensuring the truck remains stable and secure in various conditions.

2020 Ford F-150 Entertainment and Technology Features

The F-150 Raptor offers advanced technology to keep drivers connected and entertained. FordPass Connect allows smart device app compatibility, enabling remote start and cabin preconditioning. Hands-free, voice-operated phone call integration and voice-activated radio make communication and entertainment effortless. The 8-inch infotainment touchscreen with a touch screen display and seven speakers ensures clear audio and easy navigation. In-car apps from the marketplace increase functionality, while electronic messaging assistance, both read and voice-operated, help stay connected safely. These features make every drive more enjoyable and convenient.

2020 Ford F-150 Performance Features

This truck’s performance is enhanced by an active suspension system that adapts to changing terrain and driving conditions. Auto start/stop technology improves fuel efficiency when idle, while electronic suspension control allows for driver customization of ride comfort. The driver-adjustable ride control ensures a smooth or stiff ride based on preference. The electronic hi-lo 4WD selector and part-time on-demand 4WD system provide versatility for various off-road and on-road situations. Locking differentials at the center and rear offer improved traction, and the tuned off-road suspension ensures durability and stability during challenging terrains. This combination of features makes the F-150 Raptor a capable and confident performer both on and off the road.

Avalanche gives this 2023 Ford Maverick XLT a clean, modern look that fits the truck’s personality: compact enough to be easy around town, but useful enough to handle the jobs and weekend plans that make owning a pickup worthwhile. This Crew Cab pairs Ford’s 2.0-liter EcoBoost four-cylinder with an eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, creating a Maverick that feels responsive in daily traffic while adding the traction many Tampa Bay drivers want when weather or road conditions change.

The turbocharged 2.0-liter EcoBoost is the performance-focused gasoline engine in the 2023 Maverick lineup, and in this AWD configuration it delivers strong everyday response without making the truck feel oversized or cumbersome. The eight-speed automatic keeps power delivery smooth and predictable, while all-wheel drive adds useful grip for wet pavement, boat ramps, unpaved parking areas, and weekend travel. The Maverick’s compact footprint also makes it easier to maneuver through Wesley Chapel, New Tampa, and crowded Tampa parking areas than a traditional full-size pickup.

XLT trim gives this Maverick a more finished feel than a basic compact truck. Unique cloth seating, 17-inch aluminum wheels, power side mirrors, a power tailgate lock, cruise control, and convenient storage touches around the cabin and bed make the truck easier to live with every day. The Crew Cab layout seats five and gives rear passengers usable space, while the fold-up rear seat creates protected storage inside the cab for bags, tools, electronics, or other gear you would rather keep out of the weather.

Technology is straightforward and useful. The central touchscreen supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, audio functions, and phone integration, while steering-wheel controls keep frequently used functions within easy reach. A rearview camera helps when backing into tighter spaces, and Ford’s driver-assistance foundation includes Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, stability control, traction control, and the Safety Canopy airbag system.

The FLEXBED is one of the Maverick’s strongest practical features. Its 4.5-foot bed is designed to work with a variety of cargo arrangements, tie-down strategies, and do-it-yourself storage solutions. The low bed height makes loading easier than in many larger pickups, while built-in storage areas and tie-down points make the truck useful for home-improvement supplies, bicycles, camping equipment, sports gear, luggage, coolers, and other everyday cargo. The bed and Crew Cab together give the Maverick a useful balance between passenger space and pickup utility.

This Maverick is Ford Gold Certified, adding the reassurance of a 172-point inspection, a 12-month/12,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, a 7-year/100,000-mile Powertrain Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. The certification complements a relatively low-mileage truck that already combines a modern EcoBoost powertrain with a practical, easy-to-manage footprint.

Parks Plus adds another layer of ownership protection with paint, headlight, and interior protective treatments, VIN etching, roadside assistance, identity-theft protection and restoration, stolen-vehicle assistance, collision loyalty benefits, cabin sanitizer, and antimicrobial protectant.

For a buyer who wants the usefulness of a pickup without the bulk of a full-size truck, this 2023 Ford Maverick XLT AWD is an appealing middle ground. It has the power and traction to feel confident on the road, the cabin room to handle everyday family or commuting duties, and the bed versatility to make weekend projects and active lifestyles easier. From Wesley Chapel and Brandon to Clearwater, St. Petersburg, and the rest of Tampa Bay, it delivers the versatility that makes the Maverick one of Ford’s most distinctive truck designs.

The STX Appearance Package changes the personality of this 2023 Ford F-150 XL SuperCrew completely. Finished in Oxford White, this four-wheel-drive F-150 has the clean, sporty look buyers want from an STX while still keeping the capability, interior space, and everyday usability that make an F-150 so versatile. It is a strong fit for someone who wants a sharp-looking full-size truck for commuting around Wesley Chapel and Tampa, weekend projects, family use, and occasional towing or hauling without stepping into a higher luxury trim.

Power comes from Ford’s 2.7-liter EcoBoost V6 paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission. The turbocharged V6 delivers strong low-end response for pulling away from a stop, merging onto the highway, and moving a loaded truck without feeling strained. The 10-speed automatic keeps power readily available and settles into a relaxed rhythm at cruising speed. Four-wheel drive adds useful traction for wet Florida roads, boat ramps, unpaved access roads, and changing surface conditions.

The STX package is what gives this XL its visual edge. Rather than looking like a stripped-down fleet pickup, it carries a sportier exterior treatment with STX-specific details and a more finished overall presentation. Oxford White works especially well with the darker STX accents, giving the truck a crisp, modern appearance that looks just as natural in a driveway or office parking lot as it does carrying gear for a weekend project.

SuperCrew configuration adds another major advantage. Four full-size doors make entry easy, and the rear seat offers genuine space for adults, children, or coworkers. When passenger room is not the priority, the rear seating area can become secure interior storage for luggage, electronics, tools, sports equipment, or anything you would rather keep protected from the weather. That flexibility makes this F-150 useful well beyond traditional truck duty.

The pickup bed remains ready for home-improvement supplies, outdoor gear, bicycles, landscaping material, and day-to-day hauling. Ford’s full-size truck platform gives the F-150 the strength and stability expected for towing and hauling within its rated limits, while the 2.7-liter EcoBoost provides the kind of torque that makes those jobs feel natural. For buyers around Brooksville or the greater Tampa Bay area who need real truck capability without moving into a heavy-duty pickup, this configuration strikes a useful balance.

Inside, the focus is practical but modern. Durable cloth seating suits everyday use, while Ford’s SYNC interface supports smartphone connectivity, Bluetooth, audio functions, and voice control. Steering-wheel controls keep common functions close at hand, and the rearview camera helps when backing into a space, lining up in a driveway, or maneuvering around a trailer or job site.

Driver-assistance and safety technology includes Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking, stability control, traction control, antilock four-wheel disc brakes, trailer-sway control, and a comprehensive airbag system. These systems add support in traffic, during emergency braking, and when road or trailer conditions change.

This F-150 is Ford Gold Certified, adding a 172-point inspection, a 12-month/12,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, a 7-year/100,000-mile Powertrain Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance, and applicable FordPass Rewards Points.

For the buyer who likes the capability of an F-150 but does not want the plain appearance of a basic work truck, this 2023 F-150 XL with the STX Appearance Package hits the right note. It looks athletic, has the cabin room to work as a family vehicle, and still brings four-wheel-drive confidence, EcoBoost power, and full-size pickup versatility for life around Wesley Chapel, Tampa, and beyond.

Climate control is easily managed through automatic temperature adjustment and rear window defogging, ensuring comfort in any season.

Adaptive cruise control, lane keep assist, and automatic emergency braking provide additional confidence on the road. Wireless charging keeps your devices powered throughout your journey.

When it comes to capability, the X31 Off-Road Package sets this truck apart. Off-road suspension, hill descent control, and skid plates prepare you for challenging terrain. The heavy-duty air filter ensures longevity, while the dual exhaust system delivers the power and sound that defines a serious truck. The 2-speed transfer case gives you control in any driving condition.

The Sierra 1500 SLT is designed for truck owners who refuse to compromise. Whether you're towing with the included trailering package, navigating city streets, or venturing off the beaten path, this truck delivers.
